text: {"lessons":["I should not sell winning stocks just to enjoy locking in a gain; I need to weigh their future prospects against the rest of my portfolio.","I should judge each position by its outlook and risk, not let its average cost or the pain of admitting a loss dictate my decision.","After selling, I should not chase a stock back at a higher price without a clear reason; I will use consistent rules for entries, exits, and position size."]}
